exampleAnswers.title: Writing the Lower Riemann Sum for a Strictly Increasing Function

question.text:
Let $R = [3,7] \times [0,4]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y) = 2x^2+7y^2-10.$ Further, let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where \begin{align*} P_1 = \left\{x_0,x_1,\ldots, x_m\right\}, \qquad P_2 = \left\{y_0,y_1,\ldots, y_n\right\}, \qquad P = P_1\times P_2. \end{align*}

Given that the lower Riemann sum of $f$ with respect to $P$ is given by \[ L(f,P) = \sum_{i=1}^m\sum_{j=1}^n \fbox{$\phantom{AAAAA}$} \: \Delta x_i \Delta y_j \] where $\Delta x_i = x_{i} - x_{i-1}$ and $\Delta y_j = y_{j} - y_{j-1},$ what is the missing expression in the double summation above?
question.explanation:
The lower Riemann sum is given by \begin{align*} L(f,P) &= \sum_{i=1}^m\sum_{j=1}^n m_{ij}\Delta x_i \Delta y_j \end{align*} where $m_{ij}$ is the minimum value of $f$ in each subregion $R_{ij}.$

We consider an arbitrary subregion $R_{ij}$ of the partition. This subregion lies between $x_{i-1}$ and $x_i$ over the $x$-axis and $y_{i-1}$ and $y_i$ over the $y$-axis, as shown below.

Notice that:

  • $f(x,y) = 2x^2+7y^2-10$ increases as $x$ increases on $[3,7],$ and

  • $f(x,y) = 2x^2+7y^2-10$ increases as $y$ increases on $[0,4].$

As a result, the minimum value of $f$ in each subregion is attained when we have the smallest possible $x$ and the smallest possible $y.$ This is the value at the bottom left corner of each subregion.

Therefore,

\begin{align*} m_{ij} & = f(x_{i-1}, y_{j-1}) = 2x_{i-1}^2 + 7y_{j-1}^2 - 10 \end{align*} for all $1\leq i\leq m$ and $1\leq j\leq n.$

Finally, the lower Riemann sum is \begin{align*} L(f,P) &= \sum_{i=1}^m\sum_{j=1}^n ({\color{blue}{2x_{i-1}^2 + 7y_{j-1}^2 - 10}})\Delta x_i \Delta y_j. \end{align*}

So, the missing expression is $2x_{i-1}^2 + 7y_{j-1}^2 - 10.$

question.text:
Let $R = [0,1] \times [1,2]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y) = x^2+y^2+2x.$ Further, let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where

\begin{align*} P_1 = \left\{x_0,x_1,\ldots, x_m\right\}, \qquad P_2 = \left\{y_0,y_1,\ldots, y_n\right\}, \qquad P = P_1\times P_2. \end{align*}

question.explanation:
The lower Riemann sum is given by

\begin{align*} L(f,P) &= \sum_{i=1}^m\sum_{j=1}^n m_{ij}\Delta x_i \Delta y_j \end{align*}

where $m_{ij}$ is the minimum value of $f$ in each subregion $R_{ij}.$

We consider an arbitrary subregion $R_{ij}$ of the partition. This subregion lies between $x_{i-1}$ and $x_i$ over the $x$-axis and $y_{i-1}$ and $y_i$ over the $y$-axis, as shown below.

Notice that:

  • $f(x,y) = x^2+y^2+2x$ increases as $x$ increases on $[0,1]$, and

  • $f(x,y) = x^2+y^2+2x$ increases as $y$ increases on $[1,2].$

So, the missing expression is $ x_{i-1}^2 + y_{j-1}^2+2x_{i-1}.$

\begin{align*} P_1 = \left\{x_0,x_1,\ldots, x_m\right\}, \qquad P_2 = \left\{y_0,y_1,\ldots, y_n\right\}, \qquad P = P_1\times P_2. \end{align*}

Given that the lower Riemann sum of $f$ with respect to $P$ is given by \[ L(f,P) = \sum_{i=1}^m\sum_{j=1}^n \fbox{$\phantom{AAAAA}$} \: \Delta x_i \Delta y_j \] where $\Delta x_i = x_{i} - x_{i-1}$ and $\Delta y_j = y_{j} - y_{j-1},$ what is the missing expression in the double summation above?
question.explanation:
The lower Riemann sum is given by

\begin{align*} L(f,P) &= \sum_{i=1}^m\sum_{j=1}^n m_{ij}\Delta x_i \Delta y_j \end{align*}

where $m_{ij}$ is the minimum value of $f$ in each subregion $R_{ij}.$

We consider an arbitrary subregion $R_{ij}$ of the partition. This subregion lies between $x_{i-1}$ and $x_i$ over the $x$-axis and $y_{i-1}$ and $y_i$ over the $y$-axis, as shown below.

Notice that:

  • $f(x,y) = y - 2x + 10$ decreases as $x$ increases, and

  • $f(x,y) = y - 2x + 10$ increases as $y$ increases.

As a result, the minimum value of $f$ in each subregion is attained when we have the largest possible $x$ and the smallest possible $y.$ This is the value at the bottom right corner of each subregion.

Therefore,

\begin{align*} m_{ij} & = f(x_{i}, y_{j-1}) = y_{j-1} - 2x_{i} + 10 \end{align*} for all $1 \leq i \leq m$ and $1 \leq j \leq n.$

Finally, the lower Riemann sum is

\begin{align*} L(f,P) &= \sum_{i=1}^m\sum_{j=1}^n ({\color{blue}y_{j-1} - 2x_{i} + 10})\Delta x_i \Delta y_j. \end{align*}

So, the missing expression is $y_{j-1} - 2x_{i} + 10.$
